description: Runs audio analysis (segment boundaries, beats with BPM, onsets) on the project's audio files - or one standalone audio file - and caches the results next to the project for auto_edit/assemble to use. Reports progress as each file and type finishes when the call carries a progressToken.

target.description: A .audium project package or a single audio file

types.description: Comma-separated analysis types from segments, beats, onsets (default: segments,beats, what auto_edit needs)

name: analyze
title: Analyze audio
